name: Ability Counter
text: Negate an opponent's Ability Card in battle, or that targets your Haos Bakugan.

name: Air Battle
text: Move your Ventus Bakugan to a Gate Card with an opponent's Bakugan present and prevent it from opening.

name: All For One
text: All allied Bakugan have half their G's transferred to 1 of your Darkus Bakugan.

name: Aquos Cyclone
text: Your Aquos Bakugan gains +125 G's on your second turn after this Ability Card's activation.

name: Backdraft
text: Return a Bakugan back to its owner.

name: Backfire
text: Nullify the Gate Card your Pyrus Bakugan is battling on.

name: Black Is Darkness
text: Bring all adjacent enemy Bakugan to your Darkus Bakugan's Gate Card.

name: Blow Away
text: Move an opponent's Bakugan to another Gate Card.

name: Blower Plexus
text: 1 of your Ventus Bakugan gains +50 G's each time it moves. (Non-Stackable)

name: Blue Sky
text: At the start of each of your turns, draw an extra Ability Card as long as your Aquos Bakugan is on the field. (Non-Stackable)

name: Call Of The Void
text: If your deck is empty, your Darkus Bakugan gains +200 G's.

name: Copycat
text: Copy any power level changes from your opponent's last Ability Card.

name: Correlation - Aquos & Ventus
text: If there is a Ventus Bakugan on your Aquos Bakugan's Gate Card, your Aquos Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead.

name: Correlation - Darkus & Aquos
text: If there is an Aquos Bakugan on your Darkus Bakugan's Gate Card, your Darkus Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead.

name: Correlation - Haos & Darkus
text: If there is a Darkus Bakugan on your Haos Bakugan's Gate Card, your Haos Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead.

name: Correlation - Pyrus & Subterra
text: If there is a Subterra Bakugan on your Pyrus Bakugan's Gate Card, your Pyrus Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead.

name: Correlation - Subterra & Haos
text: If there is a Haos Bakugan on your Subterra Bakugan's Gate Card, your Subterra Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead.

name: Correlation - Ventus & Pyrus
text: If there is a Pyrus Bakugan on your Ventus Bakugan's Gate Card, your Ventus Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead.

name: Dark Eye Superior
text: Negate an opponent's Ability Card in battle, or that targets your Darkus Bakugan.

name: Darkus Gravity

name: Desert Hole
text: If you have more Gate Cards on the field than your opponent, your Subterra Bakugan gains +75 G's for each more.

name: Destroy Force Down
text: Each Bakugan on the field unowned by you loses -25 G's. (-15 G's in Team Battles)

name: Diagonal Link - Aquos & Subterra
text: If there is an Aquos/Subterra Bakugan on your opposite-attributed Bakugan's Gate Card, your Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, it can be on any Gate Card, and it gains +100 G's as well.

name: Diagonal Link - Pyrus & Darkus
text: If there is a Pyrus/Darkus Bakugan on your opposite-attributed Bakugan's Gate Card, your Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, it can be on any Gate Card, and it gains +100 G's as well.

name: Diagonal Link - Ventus & Haos

name: Divine Blessing

name: Doom Companion

name: Double Down

name: Hybrid Cannon
text:
Target an opponent's Bakugan, and apply an effect based on its attribute.
[Aquos]
The opponent's Bakugan has any continuous effects removed.
[Darkus]
Wired loses -200 G's, and the opponent's Bakugan loses -300 G's.
[Haos]
The opponent's Bakugan is reset to its original power level.
[Pyrus]
Wired gains +80 G's, and the opponent's Bakugan loses -80 G's.
[Subterra]
The Gate Card the opponent's Bakugan is standing on is negated.
[Ventus]
Move the opponent's Bakugan to another Gate Card.

text: Double the G's gained by the last Ability Card used on an allied Bakugan.

name: Satellite Impact
text: Nullify a Gate Card that increased an opponent's Bakugan's power level, and have an allied Bakugan gain the boost instead.

name: Saurer Cannon
text: Each of your Pyrus Bakugan on the field gains +50 G's for the rest of the game.

name: Saurus Glow
text: Saurus gains +50 G's for the rest of the game. (Stackable)

name: Scramble Zwei
text: Aquos Elico gains +50 G's and swaps attributes with another Bakugan.

name: Screw Blow
text: Swap the positions of 2 other Bakugan on the field.

name: Screw Impact
text: An opponent's Bakugan loses -80 G's, and if their hand contains an Ability Card that specifically targets that Bakugan, it is discarded.

name: Shade Cocoon
text: Transfer half of an opponent's Bakugan's G's to Nemus.

name: Shadow Echo
text: Transfer 50 G's from each opponent's Bakugan on the field to Darkus Ingram's clone. (+25 G's in Team Battles)

name: Shadow Scratch
text: Nullify the Attribute Gate Card Ravenoid is standing on, and an opponent's Bakugan loses -50 G's.

name: Shadow Split
text: Create a clone of Ingram with 100 G's on an adjacent gate card. If Ingram leaves the field, the clone does as well.

name: Shock Cannon
text: Altair gains +400 G's, and is defeated on your next turn.

name: Shooting Stardust
text: Haos Elfin gains +50 G's, and you can view all Ability Cards and Gate Cards in the opponent's hand.

name: Shower Harpoon
text: Nullify any Gate Card on the field.

name: Slash Zero
text: Fear Ripper gains +80 G's for the rest of the game. (Non-Stackable)

name: Solar Ray
text: Your Tentaclear gains +100 G's in battle.

name: Soliton Defender
text: An allied Bakugan can no longer have its power level lowered by an opponent's Gate Cards for the rest of the game.

name: Spark Out
text: Haos Ravenoid gains +50 G's and the opponent's Gate Card is nullified.

name: Spark Roa
text: 1 of your Ventus Bakugan gains +50 G's and another +50 G's each time it's thrown for the rest of the game. (Non-Stackable)

name: Spinal Saucer
text: Negate an opponent's Ability Card in battle, or that targets Ventus Altair, then Ventus Altair gains +50 G's for each normal Ventus Ability Card in your used pile.

name: Stare Down
text: All adjacent enemy Bakugan lose -50 G's.

name: Stray Thunder
text: Haos Percival attacks a random Bakugan on the field.

name: Strike Dragon
text: Neo Dragonoid individually attacks an opponent's Bakugan and moves to its Gate Card.

name: Sub Dimension
text: Target any unactivated Gate Card on the field; it becomes yours.

name: Subterra Reaction
text: Subterra Elfin gains +50 G's, and the opponent's Gate Cards become hidden to them.

name: Super Shard
text: Transfer 50 G's from any opponent's Bakugan to Juggernoid.

name: Tank Bunker
text: Negate an Ability Card that would lower an allied Bakugan's power level.

name: Thunder Booster
text: Haos Altair's G's are reset to its original power level.

name: Thunder Fire
text: An opponent's Bakugan in battle with Pyrus Altair loses -200 G's.

name: Thunder Power - Glimmering Slash
text: Ventus Hylash moves to an allied adjacent Bakugan's Gate Card. If there is an opponent's Bakugan on the Gate Card, Ventus Hylash can attack it.

name: Thunder Strike Open
text: Open any activatable Gate Card on the field, regardless of how many Bakugan are on it.

name: Thunderbolt Torrential Wave
text: Haos Ingram's clone gains +50 G's, and you or a teammate draws an Ability Card.

name: Titan Knuckle
text: An opponent's Bakugan loses -150 G's.

name: Tornado Barrier
text: Negate an Ability Card that would lower Ventus Neo Dragonoid's power level, and have the opponent's Bakugan lose the same amount of G's instead.

name: Tornado Pandemonium
text: Nullify the opponent's Attribute Gate Card.

name: Tri Gunner
text: If your opponent has 3 Bakugan on 1 Gate Card, they each lose -150 G's.

name: Trick World
text: All Bakugan on the field randomly switch places.

name: Twin Back
text: Negate an Ability Card that would lower Elfin's power level, and have Elfin gain an equal amount of G's instead.

name: Vector Phalanx
text: An allied Bakugan gains +25 G's for each Ability Card in your hand.

name: Vermillion
text: An allied Subterra Bakugan is thrown onto a Gate Card adjacent to Subterra Percival. If the Bakugan can change its attribute to Subterra, it can be thrown as well.

name: Viblow
text: Transfer 80 G's from each opponent's Bakugan in battle to Ventus Premo Vulcan.

name: Void Stream
text: An opponent's Bakugan loses -125 G's for the rest of the game.

name: Volcano Hammer
text: Pyrus Wilda gains +100 G's, and the Gate Card it's standing on is nullified.

name: Vortex Light Shift
text: Ventus Druman moves to a Gate Card with an opponent’s Bakugan present. The opponent’s Bakugan loses -200 G’s, then gets moved to another Gate Card.

name: Wind Power - Soaring Strike Shot
text: Each Ventus Ingram you control gains +50 G's.

name: Wing Mercury
text: Ventus Elfin gains +50 G's, and all Gate Cards on the field become visible to you.

name: Wizard Proxy
text: Return a Bakugan you control, then throw it onto any Gate Card.

name: Bee Striker
text: Bee Striker's power level is doubled.

name: Cycloid
text: Cycloid's power level is doubled.

name: Dragonoid
text: Dragonoid's power level is doubled.

name: Dual Hydranoid
text: Dual Hydranoid's power level is doubled.

name: Falconeer
text: Falconeer's power level is doubled.

name: Fear Ripper
text: Fear Ripper's power level is doubled.

name: Fourtress
text: Fourtress' power level is doubled.

name: Gargonoid
text: Gargonoid's power level is doubled.

name: Gorem
text: Gorem's power level is doubled.

name: Harpus
text: Harpus' power level is doubled.

name: Juggernoid
text: Juggernoid's power level is doubled.

name: Laserman
text: Laserman's power level is doubled.

name: Leonidas
text: Leonidas' power level is doubled.

name: Monarus
text: Monarus' power level is doubled.

name: Percival
text: Percival's power level is doubled.

name: Preyas
text: Preyas' power level is doubled.

name: Ravenoid
text: Ravenoid's power level is doubled.

name: Reaper
text: Reaper's power level is doubled.

name: Robotallion
text: Robotallion's power level is doubled.

name: Saurus
text: Saurus' power level is doubled.

name: Serpenoid
text: Serpenoid's power level is doubled.

name: Siege
text: Siege's power level is doubled.

name: Sirenoid
text: Sirenoid's power level is doubled.

name: Skyress
text: Skyress' power level is doubled.

name: Tentaclear
text: Tentaclear's power level is doubled.

name: Tigrerra
text: Tigrerra's power level is doubled.

name: Vladitor
text: Vladitor's power level is doubled.

name: Warius
text: Warius' power level is doubled.

name: Wilda
text: Wilda's power level is doubled.

name: Additional Task
text: The last Bakugan thrown on the Gate Card is returned to its owner and is replaced by another Bakugan from their hand.

name: Anastasis
text: All Bakugan defeated in this battle are revived.

name: Aqua Merge
text: All non-Subterra Bakugan on the field have their attribute changed to Aquos.

name: Aquos Hazard
text: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Aquos.

name: Battle Sham
text: If there are only 2 Bakugan from the same team present, 1 of them attacks a random adjacent enemy Bakugan.

name: Cheering Battle
text: Add an additional Bakugan to the battle, but its power level is reduced by 100 G's until it's less than 100 G's.

name: Darkus Hazard
text: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Darkus.

name: Double Battle
text: Both players add an additional Bakugan into battle.

name: Energy Merge
text: 100 G's are transferred from the last Bakugan to stand on the Gate Card to the first.

name: Fair Hands
text: A random Gate Card from both players' used pile is placed back on the field, open. Command Gate Cards lose their effects.

name: Final Judgement
text: All non-Haos Bakugan on this Gate Card have their power levels reduced to 0.

name: Gate Card Close
text: All Bakugan on the field are returned to their owners.

name: Grand Spirit
text: Your Bakugan gains +50 G's for each Gate Card on the field.

name: Haos Hazard
text: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Haos.

name: Hyper Merge
text: Transfer 100 G's from the side of the last Bakugan thrown on the Gate Card to each Bakugan on the side of the first.

name: Intercept
text: The battle is put on hold until another Bakugan is added to this Gate Card.

name: Joker's Wild
text: If the Gate Card contains both Darkus and Pyrus Bakugan, all non-Darkus Bakugan present are immediately defeated.

name: Level Down
text: Any Bakugan on the Gate Card with a power level of 400 G's or higher loses -100 G's.

name: Magma Fuse
text: When all ongoing brawls are over, all Gate Cards on the field are destroyed, and all Bakugan are returned to their owners.

name: Mind Ghost
text: All Bakugan present on the Gate Card are defeated.

name: Negative Delta
text: If the opponent's Bakugan is Darkus, Subterra, or Ventus, it loses -200 G's. Otherwise, the user's Bakugan loses -200 G's.

name: Peacemaker
text: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are returned to their owner's hands.

name: Positive Delta
text: If the opponent's Bakugan is Pyrus, Aquos, or Haos, it loses -200 G's. Otherwise, the user's Bakugan loses -200 G's.

name: Pyrus Hazard
text: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Pyrus.

name: Quartet Battle
text: Both sides add Bakugan to the Gate Card until at least 4 are present.

name: Quicksand Freeze
text: The Bakugan that wins on this Gate Card remains on it after battle, and its power level is reduced to 0 as long as it stays.

name: Reinforcement
text: Your Bakugan's power level increases by 100 G's for each other Bakugan on your side of the field with the same attribute.

name: Revive
text: The winning player revives a defeated Bakugan.

name: Scapegoat
text: The owner of the first Bakugan to land on this Gate Card can decide to continue the battle or return all Bakugan present to their owner's hand..

name: Subterra Hazard
text: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Subterra.

name: Supernova
text: All Bakugan present on the Gate Cards have their power levels swapped.

name: Switchback
text: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to their original attributes.

name: Third Judgement
text: The battle can only start when there are 3 Bakugan on the Gate Card, and only 1 Bakugan can win.

name: Trade Off
text: Either side with a combined power level of over 400 G's is defeated.

name: Transformation
text: Your Bakugan's G-Power becomes equal to that of the strongest undefeated Bakugan you have in your hand.

name: Triple Battle
text: The user can add an additional Bakugan to the battle, or the battle is put on hold until there are at least 3 present on the Gate Card.

name: Ventus Hazard
text: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Ventus.

name: Wall Lock
text: All power level changes for Bakugan on this Gate Card are negated.

name: Warp Gate
text: All Bakugan on this Gate Card are moved to another.
